name: BE Semiconductor Industries N.V.
blurb: BE Semiconductor Industries N.V. (BESI) is a Dutch company that designs, develops, and manufactures advanced assembly equipment for the semiconductor industry. It specializes in die bonding, packaging, and plating solutions used in the production of integrated circuits. BESI holds a leading market position in hybrid bonding and advanced packaging technologies, serving major chipmakers and OSATs globally.
recent: In the past 30 days, BESI stock reached a 52-week high of €263.80 on May 6, 2026, reflecting strong investor sentiment driven by demand for advanced packaging equipment. The company continues to benefit from the AI and high-performance computing megatrends, with analysts highlighting its exposure to hybrid bonding technology. No major earnings or news events were reported in the period.
